(Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: Wall Street Asks What Can Save AI Trade After Anthropic Wipeout
general.summary: It’s been a tough month for the stock market, rocked by back-to-back punches from the stunning ouster of Jensen Huang from Nvidia Corp. and the Democrats’ decisive victory in the midterm elections.

general.title: Anthropic Makes Its Public Market Debut
general.summary: Bloomberg’s Ed Ludlow tells Bloomberg This Weekend that Anthropic’s landmark IPO tested investor appetite for frontier AI, giving the company fresh capital for its enormous computing needs as OpenAI considers its own path to the public markets. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Ludlow also examines the turmoil at Nvidia following Jensen Huang’s departure and the uncertainty surrounding the chipmaker’s search for new leadership. (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: Russian Cargo Ship Attacked By Drones in Gulf of Finland
general.summary: Russia said a cargo ship bound for its Kaliningrad exclave was targeted in international waters in the Gulf of Finland, highlighting growing risks to the country’s energy and food exports through critical Baltic Sea shipping routes.
